description: The CT Cranium DICOM scan is already loaded in InVesalius 3. Create a solid 3D model of the cranium that represents the total cranial volume (bone + internal brain cavity) but excludes external soft tissues. Steps: (1) Create a Bone mask (using the Bone preset ~226-3071 HU); (2) Use the 'Fill Holes' mask operation on all slices to fill the intracranial cavity; (3) Generate a 3D surface from this filled mask; (4) Export the surface as a binary STL file to /home/ga/Documents/solid_cranium.stl. Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
